# Deduct tax from your payment

You can ask us to deduct tax from most taxable Centrelink payments. This can help reduce how much tax you may have to pay at the end of the tax year.

Select your payment or service to find out how this impacts you:

### Raising kids

- [Child Care Subsidy](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=41186)
- [Child support assessment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=21911)
- [Family Tax Benefit](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=22151)
- [Parental Leave Pay](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=64479)
- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=22196)

- [Special Benefit](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=22281)
